name: Siliform
tagline: SiliForm is an AI-powered conversational form and survey builder
description: SiliForm is an AI-powered conversational form and survey builder. Instead of a wall of fields, respondents answer one question at a time in a chat-like flow that adapts to earlier answers — later questions even greet them by name. The responses are flagged if they are suspicious/invalid. Describe your form in plain language and AI generates the full structure, with branching logic, scoring, and real-time answer validation built in.
